mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the stretch receptors was most worthwhile because it connected muscle activity to sensory feedback and explained how a movement can be adjusted while underway.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the motor nerves to the arm felt somewhat predictable: it was the only combination offered, and the preceding result had already pointed to it.

surprise.text: I was interested to learn that the spinal cord participates in local responses rather than merely carrying signals to and from the brain.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt arbitrary; each had a clear role in linking sight, coordination, movement or feedback.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the guided arm connects with other body systems, especially after the feedback result showed that movement involves more than sending a command.
